notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (data.js fy 'Dec 2025'). Financial figures are from the FY2025 Form 10-K (accession 0001633917-26-000024, filed February 3, 2026) and match SEC XBRL; ownership is from the 2026 proxy (DEF 14A filed April 7, 2026, accession 0001193125-26-145721), shares as of March 25, 2026 (899,673,971 outstanding). SCHULMAN: he was CEO until September 2023 (the 2026 proxy's pay-versus-performance notes say 'Mr. Schulman served as the Principal Executive Officer ("PEO") in 2023 from January 1 through September 26'). He is not a director or named executive officer in the 2026 proxy and is not in its security ownership tables, so his status is no-reported-stake. The company's CEO has changed again: the proxy says the Board 'appointed Enrique Lores as PayPal's President and CEO effective March 1' 2026, succeeding Alex Chriss. HOLDERS: the proxy bases Vanguard's 10.05% on a Schedule 13G/A filed January 30, 2026, and adds that a later 13G/A (Amendment No. 10, filed March 27, 2026) reports The Vanguard Group 'does not beneficially own any shares' after an internal reorganization that disaggregated its beneficial ownership; the table's figure is kept as the proxy lists it. BlackRock's 8.06% still rests on a Schedule 13G/A filed January 26, 2024, so it is stale. The proxy gives filing dates, not holding dates, so asOf is null. DIVIDENDS: PayPal began a quarterly dividend in October 2025; the first, $0.14 per share (about $130 million), was paid December 10, 2025. BUYBACKS exclude $383 million of tax withholdings on net share settlement of equity awards. STOCK COMP is the cash-flow add-back; the equity statement shows $1,135 million of stock-based compensation.
